50601.meaning1: Discourses on Blessings, on Jewels, to Nālaka and to Tuvaṭṭaka
50601.construction:
maṅgalasutta + ratanasutta + nālakasutta + tuvaṭṭakasutta + āni
maṅgalasuttaratanasuttanālakasuttatuvaṭṭakasutta + āni
50601.compound: dvanda (maṅgalasutta ca ratanasutta ca nālakasutta ca tuvaṭṭakasutta ca)

examples.text: tattha ubhato-vibhaṅga-niddesa-khandhaka-parivārā, suttanipāte maṅgalasutta-ratanasutta-nālakasutta-tuvaṭṭakasuttāni ca aññam'pi ca suttanāmakaṃ tathāgatavacanaṃ suttan'ti veditabbaṃ. sabbam'pi sagāthakaṃ suttaṃ geyyan'ti veditabbaṃ.

50605.commentary: (DHPa) rañño maṅgalahatthīpi alaṅ'kato javamāno na sobhati, vāraṇalīḷāya gacchanto'va sobhati.

examples.text: evam'etesu ekādasasu janesu kurudhammaṃ rakkhantesu kaliṅgaraṭṭhe dantapuranagare kaliṅge rajjaṃ kārente tasmiṃ raṭṭhe devo na vassi. mahāsattassa pana añjanasannibho nāma maṅgalahatthī mahāpuñño hoti.

sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.

50608.meaning1: superstitious; believing in what is auspicious

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. gihī, bhikkhave, maṅgalikā. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gihīnaṃ maṅgal'atthāya yāciyamānena celappaṭikaṃ akkamitun'ti.
tasmiṃ samaye bārāṇasivāsino devatāmaṅgalikā honti, devatā namassanti, bahū aj'eḷakakukkuṭasūkar'ādayo vadhitvā nānappakārehi pupphagandhehi c'eva maṃsalohitehi ca balikammaṃ karonti
jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
kāḷo samaṇo gotamo'ti. ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, sāmo samaṇo gotamo'ti. ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, na'pi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo'ti.

50612.meaning1: with a sallow complexion; with yellowish skin

examples.text: jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ purisaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, kāḷo vā sāmo vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti
idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ itthiṃ duggandhaṃ maṅguliṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kākā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.

50615.meaningLit: discourse on the hideously ugly woman

examples.text: nicchav'itthi aticārinī ahu, maṅgul'itthi ahu ikkhaṇ'itthikā.

50617.commentary: (ANa) macalappatto'ti rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa puttabhāvena c'eva puttesu jeṭṭhakabhāvena ca na tāva abhisittabhāvena ca abhisekappattiatthāya acalappatto niccalapatto. makāro nipātamattaṃ.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo āsaṃso? idha, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti ābhiseko anabhisitto macalappatto. so suṇāti, itthan'nāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto'ti.
accayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ uparujjhati, āyu khīyati maccānaṃ, kunnadīnaṃ'va odakaṃ.
ubho puññañ'ca pāpañ'ca, yaṃ macco kurute idha, tañ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, tañ'ca ādāya gacchati, tañ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
yathā'pi kumbhakārassa, kataṃ mattikabhājanaṃ, khuddakañ'ca mahantañ'ca, yañ'ca pakkaṃ yañ'ca āmakaṃ, sabbaṃ bhedapariyantaṃ, evaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ.
yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvit'indriyassa upacchedo, idaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ.
aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.
kadā aniccaṃ vadharoganīḷaṃ, kāyaṃ imaṃ maccujarāy'upaddutaṃ, vipassamāno vītabhayo vihassaṃ, eko vane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
saṅg'ātigo maccujaho nirupadhi, pahāsi dukkhaṃ apunabbhavāya, atthaṅ'gato so na pun'eti, amohayī maccurājan'ti brūmī'ti.

50624.meaning1: who surpasses death; who passes beyond death

examples.text: suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu, mogharāja sadā sato, att'ānudiṭṭhiṃ ūhacca, evaṃ maccutaro siyā, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passatī'ti.

50625.meaning1: realm of death; sphere of death; power of death
50625.commentary: (SNa) maccudheyyassā'ti tebhūmakavaṭṭassa. tañ'hi maccuno patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena maccudheyyan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.
tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.

50626.meaning1: afflicted with death; assailed by death; attacked by death

examples.text: maccun'ābbhāhato loko, jarāya parivārito. taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo, icchādhūpāyito sadā'ti.

50627.meaning1: subject to death; destined to die

examples.text: yo'pi vassasataṃ jīve, so'pi maccuparāyaṇo, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'ev'ābhimaddatī'ti.

50628.meaning1: destined for death; bound for the grave

examples.text: yo'pi vassasataṃ jīve, sabbe maccuparāyanā, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'ev'ābhimaddatī'ti.

50630.meaning1: death's snare; noose of death; death's trap

examples.text: piṇḍikāya paviṭṭho'haṃ, gacchanto naṃ udikkhisaṃ, alaṅ'kataṃ suvasanaṃ, maccupāsaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ.
it'āyaṃ kodharūpena, maccupāso guh'āsayāo, taṃ damena samucchinde, paññāvīriyena diṭṭhiyā.

50631.meaning1: release from the snare of death; freedom from death's trap
50631.commentary: (ANa) maccupāsappamocanan'ti maccupāsā pamocanakaṃ maggaṃ. (SNPa) upasaṅkamma pucchāma, maccupāsappamocanan'ti taṃ evarūpaṃ mah'esiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tebhūmakavaṭṭassa maccupāsassa pamocanaṃ vivaṭṭaṃ nibbānaṃ pucchāma.

examples.text: yo vedi sabbasattānaṃ, maccupāsappamocanaṃ, hitaṃ devamanussānaṃ, ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ pakāsayi, yaṃ ve disvā ca sutvā ca, pasīdanti bahū janā [pasīdati bahujjano].
sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, maccupāsappamocanaṃ.

50632.meaning1: Māra in the sense of death

examples.text: passāmi loke pariphandamānaṃ, pajaṃ imaṃ taṇhagataṃ bhavesu, hīnā narā maccumukhe lapanti, avītataṇhāse bhav'ābhavesu.
evaṃ dhammā apakkamma, adhammam'anuvattiya, mando maccumukhaṃ patto, akkhacchinno'va jhāyatī'ti.
uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, daḷhaṃ sikkhatha santiyā, mā vo pamatte viññāya, maccurājā amohayittha vas'ānuge.
ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.

50635.meaning1: approaching of the king of death

examples.text: yo puññakāmo kusale patiṭṭhito, bhāveti maggaṃ amatassa pattiyā, so dhammasār'ādhigamo khaye rato, na vedhati maccurāj'āgamanasmin'ti.
sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, vītagedhassa brāhmaṇa, āsavā'ssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje'ti.

50637.meaning1: under the power of death; under death's domain
50637.meaningLit: going with the control of death

examples.text: ye me pavutte siṭṭhipade, anusikkhanti jhāyino, kāle te appamajjantā, na maccuvasagā siyun'ti.

50638.meaning1: who has abandoned death; who has left death behind; who has dispelled death

examples.text: ye ca rūpe pariññāya, arūpesu asaṇṭhitā, nirodhe ye vimuccanti, te janā maccuhāyino'ti.
phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā, macche app'odake yathā, aññam'aññehi byāruddhe, disvā maṃ bhayam'āvisi.
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūtī vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kumārakā antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca jetavanaṃ macchake bādhenti.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā macchagaṇasaṃghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
tadā pajjunno ānandatthero ahosi, macchagaṇā buddhaparisā, maccharājā lokanātho.

50642.meaning1: lived in by schools of different fish

examples.text: mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā macchagaṇasaṃghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.

50643.meaning1: school of fish; shoal of fish

examples.text: najjāyo supatitthāyo, soṇṇavālukasanthatā, acchā savanti ambūni, macchagumbanisevitā.
tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukam'pi sakkharakathalam'pi macchagumbam'pi, carantam'pi tiṭṭhantam'pi.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti sūkariko sākuṇiko māgaviko luddo macchaghātako coro coraghātako goghātako bandhan'āgāriko, ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci kurūrakamm'antā.
tatr'idaṃ, bhante, pūraṇena kassapena kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, orabbhikā sūkarikā sākuṇikā māgavikā luddā macchaghātakā corā coraghātakā bandhan'āgārikā ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci kurūrakamm'antā.

50649.meaning2: kind of sugar having the appearance of fish-eggs

50652.commentary: (KVt) macchabandhānan'ti kevaṭṭānaṃ. (APt) macche bandhati jālenā'ti macchabandho, macche vadhatī'ti vā macchabandho

examples.text: tatiyadhammasamādāne idh'ekacco macchabandho vā hoti, māgaviko vā, pāṇ'upaghātaṃ'y'eva nissāya jīvikaṃ kappeti. tassa garuṭṭhāniyo bhikkhu akāmakass'eva pāṇ'ātipāte ādīnavaṃ, pāṇ'ātipātaviratiyā ca ānisaṃsaṃ kathetvā sikkhāpadaṃ deti.
na jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ. yo paribhuñjeyya āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ, adiṭṭhaṃ assutaṃ aparisaṅkitan'ti.

50656.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.
kāle dadanti sappaññā, vadaññū vītamaccharā. kālena dinnaṃ ariyesu, ujubhūtesu tādisu. vippasannamanā tassa, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.

50657.commentary: (NIDD1) maccharan'ti pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ. yaṃ evarūpaṃ macchariyaṃ maccharāyanaṃ maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa, idaṃ vuccati macchariyaṃ. api ca, khandhamacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ, dhātumacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ, āyatanamacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ gāho. idaṃ vuccati macchariyan'ti, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca.
50657.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: yā annapānaṃ dadatippamoditā, sīl'ūpapannā sugatassa sāvikā, dadāti dānaṃ abhibhuyya maccharaṃ, sovaggikaṃ sokanudaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.
sokapparidevamaccharaṃ, na jahanti giddhā mamāyite, tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ, hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.

50658.commentary: (NIDD1) macchariyan'ti pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ. yaṃ evarūpaṃ macchariyaṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa, idaṃ vuccati macchariyaṃ.
50658.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.

50659.commentary: (DNa) maccharāyatī'ti mā aññassa arahattaṃ hotū'ti kiṃ bhagavā evaṃ arahattassa maccharāyatī'ti pucchati.
50659.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: guṇavantānañ'hi guṇaṃ buddhā eva pākaṭaṃ kātuṃ sakkonti, avasesajano guṇavantānaṃ guṇaṃ kathento maccharāyati
evaṃ, bhante. kiṃ pana, bhante, bhagavā arahattassa maccharāyatī'ti? na kho ahaṃ, moghapurisa, arahattassa maccharāyāmi.

50660.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

50661.commentary: (VVt) maccharāyantī'ti maccharaṃ karontī, attano paccayadāyakakulassa aññehi sādhāraṇabhāvaṃ asahantī'ti attho.
50661.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

50663.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: macchariyaṃ cittassa upakkileso'ti, iti viditvā macchariyaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
nindāya nappavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ'ca panudeyya.

50664.meaning1: end of selfishness; cessation of stinginess
50664.meaning2: end of selfishness; cessation of stinginess

examples.text: macchariyañ'ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso macchariye asati macchariyanirodhā api nu kho ārakkho paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

50670.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: na vākkaraṇamattena, vaṇṇapokkharatāya vā, sādhurūpo naro hoti, issukī maccharī saṭho.
rosako kadariyo ca, pāp'iccho maccharī saṭho, ahiriko anottappī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

50671.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: yass'eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī, tadev'ādadato bhayaṃ, jighacchā ca pipāsā ca, yassa bhāyati maccharī, tam'eva bālaṃ phusati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
ye'dha maccharino loke, kadariyā paribhāsakā, aññesaṃ dadamānānaṃ, antarāyakarā narā.

50674.meaning1: people of Maccha and Surasena; Macchas and Surasenas

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu macchasurasenesu

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu macchasūrasenesu

50676.meaning1: catch of fish; haul of fish
50676.commentary: (ANa) kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti kevaṭṭā viya macchavilope. tesañ'hi macchapacchiṃ gahetvā āgatānaṃ vikkiṇanaṭṭhāne, mayhaṃ detha mayhaṃ dethā'ti vadato mahājanassa evarūpo saddo hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi, ke pana kho, nāgita, uccāsaddamahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti?
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu macchasurasenesu
pañcāla-paccuggata-sūrasena, macchā ca maddā saha kekakebhi, passantu asaṭhena yuddhaṃ, na no sabhāyaṃ na karonti kiñci.
orabbhikā sūkarikā, macchikā migabandhakā, corā ca vajjhaghātā ca, ye c'aññe pāpakammino, dak'ābhisecanā te'pi, pāpakammā pamuccare.

50680.meaning1: name of a forest in Kāsi

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū macchikāsaṇḍe viharanti ambāṭakavane.

50681.meaning1: from Macchikā's grove; living in Macchikā's grove

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ citto gahapati macchikāsaṇḍiko.

50684.commentary: (MNa) attano sampattinigūhanalakkhaṇaṃ maccheraṃ, attano sampattiyā parehi sādhāraṇabhāv'āsukhāyanarasaṃ, saṅkocanapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.
50684.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: mal'itthiyā duccaritaṃ, maccheraṃ dadato malaṃ, malā ve pāpakā dhammā, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
maccherā ca pamādā ca, evaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati, puññaṃ ākaṅkhamānena, deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā'ti.

50685.meaning1: stain of stinginess; tarnish of selfishness
50685.commentary: (ITIa) na ca nesaṃ maccheramalaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭheyyā'ti attano sampattīnaṃ parehi sādhāraṇa-bhāv'āsahana-lakkhaṇaṃ cittassa pabhassarabhāvadūsakānaṃ upakkilesabhūtānaṃ kaṇhadhammānaṃ aññataraṃ maccheramalaṃ. atha vā yathāvuttamaccherañ'c'eva aññam'pi dān'antarāyakaraṃ issālobhados'ādimalañ'ca nesaṃ sattānaṃ cittaṃ yathā dānacetanā na pavattati, na vā suparisuddhā hoti, evaṃ pariyādāya parito gahetvā abhibhavitvā na tiṭṭheyya. ko hi samma'd'eva dānaphalaṃ jānanto attano citte maccheramalassa okāsaṃ dadeyya.

examples.text: vineyya maccheramalaṃ, vippasannena cetasā, dajjuṃ kālena ariyesu, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.

50686.meaning1: obsessed by the stain of stinginess
50686.commentary: (SNa) maccheramala-pariyuṭṭhitenā'ti pubb'aṇha-samayasmiñ'hi mātugāmo khīra-dadhi-saṅgopana-randhana-pacan'ādīni kātuṃ āraddho, puttakehi'pi yāciyamāno kiñci dātuṃ na icchati. ten'etaṃ vuttaṃ pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ maccheramala-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā'ti.

examples.text: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me! yo'haṃ maccheramala-pariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato'ti.

50687.meaning1: connected with selfishness; tied up with meanness

examples.text: piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.
maccheravinaye yuttaṃ, saccaṃ kodh'ābhibhuṃ naraṃ, taṃ ve devā tāvatiṃsā, āhu sappuriso itī'ti.
pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti

kukkuccaṃ upadaheyyā'ti ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno, vikāle maññe tayā bhuttaṃ, majjaṃ maññe tayā pītaṃ, mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho maññe tayā nisinnan'ti kukkuccaṃ upadahati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

50690.commentary: (VINa) amajjañ'ca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasan'ti loṇasovīrakaṃ vā suttaṃ vā hoti.

examples.text: anāpatti amajjañ'ca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasaṃ taṃ pivati, sūpasampāke, maṃsasampāke, telasampāke, āmalakaphāṇite, amajjaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ pivati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

50691.meaning1: is intoxicated; is stupefied; is befuddled (by)

examples.text: rajanīye rajjati, dussanīye dussati, mohanīye muyhati, kuppanīye kuppati, madanīye majjati.
phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.

50692.meaning1: becomes arrogant; (comm) becomes intoxicated with self-importance

examples.text: appakā te sattā lokasmiṃ ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā na c'eva majjanti, na ca pamajjanti, na ca kāmesu gedhaṃ āpajjanti, na ca sattesu vippaṭipajjanti.
aham'asmi lābhasakkārasilokavā, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti. so tena lābhasakkārasilokena majjati pamajjati pamādaṃ āpajjati, pamatto samāno dukkhaṃ viharati.
lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho'ti yattha katthaci lubbhanalakkhaṇo lobho ca, dussanalakkhaṇo doso ca, majjanalakkhaṇo mado ca, muyhanalakkhaṇo moho ca.
aparam'pi divasaṃ nāgarājā saparivāro nhān'atthāya chaddantadahaṃ otari. atha dve taruṇanāgā soṇḍāhi usirakalāpe gahetvā kelāsakūṭaṃ majjantā viya nhāpesuṃ.
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.
